scope: Read-only original default code audit, symbolic instruction verification and adapter algebra. No original DLL execution or live-state observation.

shader_pair.injected: Normal newly created offscreen UI draw has _RenderPathInjected=1, as proved by the original null payload constructor/callback in hg-ui-render-target.json.

world_camera_position.name: _WorldSpaceCameraPos_Internal
world_camera_position.convention: World position is copied unchanged. The camera-view Z reflection affects the matrix basis, not this position vector.

zero_translation.source: Original source-view columns 0..2 are preserved exactly; column 3 becomes (0,0,0,1).

offscreen_pretransform.caller: 0x188ebd96d passes whether any color attachment is a backbuffer to HGUtils.GetPreTransformMatrix
offscreen_pretransform.callback_prepare: 0x188ebd9e5 calls PrepareBasicCameraTransforms with the returned matrix

callback_upload.prepare_condition: Camera identity or backbuffer classification changed from the previous callback; retained prepared constants are used otherwise.
callback_upload.current_cb_upload: 0x188ebdabb copies the first 720 bytes of BasicTransformConstants (CurrentViewTransformConstants), then 0x188ebdaf4 appends 64 bytes of UIShaderVariablesGlobal.
callback_upload.render_graph_path: Original UI pass SetupRenderFunc/ExecuteSubpassRenderFunc -> HGRenderGraph.InvokeOwnerCallback -> this owner callback, before rendering the pass.

adaptation.requirement: Set Injected=1 together with camera world position and a matching no-translation VP. Do not subtract camera position then multiply an absolute VP that already contains its translation.
adaptation.equality: For the original normal transform-derived affine view V and camera C: zeroTranslation(V) × (world.xyz-C,1) = V × (world.xyz,1). Multiplying either side by the same GPU P and preTransform preserves clip position.
adaptation.original_default_view: Camera API view contains the engine Z reflection S=diag(1,1,-1), previously proved in hg-ui-camera-constants.json. Keep it paired with the projection/basis adapter. Do not negate camera position Z to imitate this reflection.
adaptation.gpu_y: Source non-jittered P is built through GL.GetGPUProjectionMatrix(...,true). The source final shader clip-Y conversion and Metal adapter projection/RT convention must remain coordinated; translation removal adds no Y flip.
adaptation.custom_view_boundary: The source still reads actual Transform.position if a custom view matrix were installed; the affine equivalence above assumes the normal transform-derived camera view. No Watch-specific custom-view setter was proved in the bounded earlier audit.
not_established: Complete C++ alternative render-path equivalence or runtime IFix replacements.
Live camera/RT orientation, external volume state, or pixel-equivalence to the recording.
